name: Case Administration
definition: Coordination and compliance matters, including preparation of statement of financial affairs; schedules; list of contracts; United States Trustee interim statements and operating reports; contacts with the United States Trustee; general creditor inquiries.

name: Asset Analysis and Recovery
definition: Identification and review of potential assets including causes of action and non-litigation recoveries.

name: Asset Disposition
definition: Sales, abandonment and transaction work related to asset disposition.

name: Relief from Stay/Adequate Protection Proceedings
definition: Matters relating to termination or continuation of automatic stay under 362 and motions for adequate protection.

name: Meetings of and Communications with Creditors
definition: Preparing for and attending the conference of creditors, the 341(a) meeting and other creditors' committee meetings.

name: Fee/Employment Applications
definition: Preparations of employment and fee applications for self or others; motions to establish interim procedures.

name: Fee/Employment Objections
definition: Review of and objections to the employment and fee applications of others.

name: Avoidance Action Analysis
definition: Review of potential avoiding actions under Sections 544-549 of the Code to determine whether adversary proceedings are warranted.

name: Assumption/Rejection of Leases and Contracts
definition: Analysis of leases and executory contracts and preparation of motions specifically to assume or reject.

name: Other Contested Matters (excluding assumption/rejection motions)
definition: Analysis and preparation of all other motions, opposition to motions and reply memoranda in support of motions.

name: Non-Working Travel
definition: Non-working travel where the court reimburses at less than full hourly rates.

name: Business Operations
definition: Issues related to debtor-in-possession operating in chapter 11 such as employee, vendor, tenant issues and other similar problems.

name: Employee Benefits/Pensions
definition: Review issues such as severance, retention, 401K coverage and continuance of pension plan.

name: Financing/Cash Collections
definition: Matters under 361, 363 and 364 including cash collateral and secured claims; loan document analysis.

name: Tax Issues
definition: Analyses and advice regarding tax-related issues, including the preservation of net operating loss carry forwards.

name: Real Estate
definition: Review and analysis of real estate-related matters, including purchase agreements and lease provisions (e.g., common area maintenance clauses).

name: Board of Directors Matters
definition: Preparation of materials for and attendance at Board of Directors meetings; analysis and advice regarding corporate governance issues and review and preparation of corporate documents (e.g., Articles, Bylaws, employment agreements, compensation plans, etc.)

name: Claims Administration and Objections
definition: Specific claim inquiries; bar date motions; analyses, objections and allowances of claims.

name: Plan and Disclosure Statement (including Business Plan)
definition: Formulation, presentation and confirmation; compliance with the plan confirmation order, related orders and rules; disbursement and case closing activities, except those related to the allowance and objections to allowance of claims.

name: General Bankruptcy Advice/Opinions
definition: Analysis, advice and/or opinions regarding potential bankruptcy related issues, where no bankruptcy case has been filed.

name: Restructurings
definition: Analysis, consultation and drafting in connection with the restructuring of agreements, including financing agreements, where no bankruptcy case has been filed.

name: Asset Analysis and Recovery
definition: Identification and review of potential assets including causes of action and non-litigation recoveries.

name: Asset Disposition
definition: Sales, leases (section 365 matters), abandonment and related transaction work related to asset disposition.

name: Assumption and Rejection of Leases and Contracts
definition: Analysis of leases and executory contracts and preparation of motions specifically to assume or reject.

name: Avoidance Action Analysis
definition: Review of potential avoiding actions under Sections 544–549 of the Code to determine whether adversary proceedings are warranted.

name: Budgeting (Case)
definition: Preparation, negotiation, and amendment to budgets for applicant.

name: Business Operations
definition: Issues related to debtor-in-possession operating in chapter 11 such as employee, vendor, tenant issues and other similar problems.

name: Case Administration
definition: Coordination and compliance activities not specifically covered by another category.

name: Claims Administration and Objections
definition: Specific claim inquiries; bar date motions; analyses, objections and allowances of claims.

name: Corporate Governance and Board Matters
definition: Preparation for and attendance at Board of Directors meetings; analysis and advice regarding corporate governance issues, including trustee, examiner, and CRO issues; review and preparation of corporate documents (e.g., articles and bylaws, etc.).

name: Employee Benefits and Pensions
definition: Review and preparation related to employee and retiree benefit issues, including compensation, bonuses, severance, insurance benefits, and 401K, pensions, or other retirement plans.

name: Employment and Fee Applications
definition: Preparation of employment and fee applications for self or others; motions to establish interim procedures.

name: Employment and Fee Application Objections
definition: Review of and objections to the employment and fee applications of others.

name: Financing and Cash Collateral
definition: Matters under sections 361, 363 and 364 including cash collateral and secured claims; loan document analysis.

name: Litigation
definition: Contested Matters and Adversary Proceedings (not otherwise within a specific project category), each identified separately by caption and adversary number, or title of motion or application and docket number, and using the Uniform Task Based Management System (‘‘UTBMS’’) Litigation Task Code Set.3

name: Meetings and Communications with Creditors
definition: Preparation for and attendance at section 341(a) meeting and any other meetings with creditors and creditors’ committees.

name: Non-Working Travel
definition: Non- working travel where the court reimburses at less than full hourly rates.

name: Plan and Disclosure Statement
definition: Formulation, presentation and confirmation; compliance with the plan confirmation order, related orders and rules; disbursement and case closing activities, except those related to the allowance and objections to allowance of claims.

name: Real Estate
definition: Review and analysis of real estate-related matters, including purchase agreements and lease provisions (e.g., common area maintenance clauses).

name: Relief from Stay and Adequate Protection
definition: Matters relating to termination or continuation of automatic stay under 11 U.S.C. 362 and motions for adequate protection under 11 U.S.C. 361.

name: Reporting
definition: Statement of financial affairs, schedules, monthly operating reports, and any other accounting or reporting activities; contacts with the United States Trustee not included in other categories.

name: Tax
definition: Analysis of tax issues and preparation of federal and state tax returns.

name: Valuation
definition: Appraise or review appraisals of assets.
